title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-05-03
source: SBD/PA Reel: TASCAM 22-2 modified for flat transfer. Reel-> Tascam 22-2 -> Tascam MKII DR-07 (24-bit, 96kHz) - DC8Forensics for editing and modification

ai_review.summary: Excellent early audience recording featuring a monster Other One and rare, beloved versions of He Was a Friend of Mine and Doing That Rag.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this early‑era show, calling it an “excellent” fixed AUD tape with standout performances of The Other One, He Was a Friend of Mine, and Doing That Rag. The recording is praised as clear and enjoyable despite its age, making it a favorite for fans of the 1969 period.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews highlight both superb musical moments and a high‑quality audience recording, indicating an exceptional show with excellent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fixed AUD tape; listeners note crystal‑clear sound for an early crowd source, no major glitches or dropouts mentioned.

standout_songs: He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑era set that blends folk‑ballads with exploratory jams; the highlighted tracks showcase the band’s emerging improvisational chemistry.
